title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
authors_zh: Yujia Qin 等（Tsinghua University、ModelBest Inc.、Renmin University of China、Yale University、WeChat AI, Tencent Inc.、Zhihu Inc.）
paper_type_zh: ICLR 2024 spotlight 的评测面 / 环境基准
best_for_zh: 关注工具使用数据构造、多工具调用轨迹、RapidAPI 漂移和自动评审耦合风险的读者。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16789. Public status: ICLR 2024 spotlight, 2023. Open-source language models had weak tool-use ability because ordinary instruction tuning underrepresented real API use. ToolLLM asks how to construct tool-use data and evaluate API-using behavior at scale.

The evaluation object is user instruction, selected APIs, tool-call chain, API observations, final answer or failure, and ToolEval judgment. The feedback contract is ToolEval uses closed-model judgments of pass rate and win rate over full tool-use trajectories. This belongs in the collection as an auditable benchmark or environment surface; it is not by itself proof of deployable reliability, and training use should be inferred only where the paper explicitly releases data for that purpose.

一手来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16789。公开状态是 ICLR 2024 spotlight，年份为 2023。开源语言模型工具使用能力弱，一个原因是普通指令微调很少覆盖真实 API 使用。ToolLLM 关注如何大规模构造工具使用数据并评测 API 调用行为。

评测对象包括用户指令、选中的 API、工具调用链、API 返回结果、最终答案或失败状态，以及 ToolEval 判断。反馈契约是 ToolEval 对完整工具使用轨迹的通过率和胜率判断。它应作为工具使用数据、环境轨迹和评测器的组合来读；不能把 ToolBench、ToolLLaMA 和 ToolEval 混成同一个证据对象。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: ToolLLM introduces ToolBench, a large tool-use dataset over 16,464 real-world APIs, plus ToolEval and ToolLLaMA for training and evaluating API-using models. The contribution has three linked parts: ToolBench data construction from RapidAPI, DFSDT solution-path search and ToolLLaMA training, and ToolEval for automatic trajectory evaluation.

The data object contains API schema, user instruction, retrieved tool, tool call, API observation, solution path, final answer, ToolEval score. Success is decided by the tool-call chain satisfies the user instruction or wins against a comparison trajectory under ToolEval. Closest comparisons are static web benchmarks, tool-use datasets, or code benchmarks in the same domain, but the direction label here is the concrete evaluation surface and its verifier rather than a general capability claim.

一句话贡献：ToolLLM 提出 ToolBench：覆盖 16,464 个真实 API 的工具使用数据集，并配套 ToolEval 与 ToolLLaMA 用于训练和评测。主要贡献由三部分组成：从 RapidAPI 构造 ToolBench 数据，用 DFSDT 搜索解题路径并训练 ToolLLaMA，以及用 ToolEval 自动评测轨迹。

数据对象包含 API 模式、用户指令、检索到的工具、工具调用、API 观测、解题路径、最终答案和 ToolEval 分数。成功条件是工具调用链满足用户指令，或在 ToolEval 中优于对比轨迹。最接近的对比对象是 APIBench、ToolBench 后续稳定化版本和其他工具调用评测，但这里的方向标签应同时覆盖训练数据、工具环境轨迹和评测器。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are RapidAPI documentation filtered by the authors, with closed-chat-model-generated single-tool and multi-tool user instructions. Outputs are user instruction, selected APIs, tool-call chain, API observations, final answer or failure, and ToolEval judgment. The substrate is RapidAPI tool bank, API retriever, DFSDT solution-path search, and ToolEval judging.

Pipeline: 1. construct or load the task instance; 2. run the model or system under the official harness; 3. collect actions, observations, answers, or predicted structures; 4. apply ToolEval uses closed-model judgments of pass rate and win rate over full tool-use trajectories; 5. aggregate scores only under a pinned version of the benchmark. Reproducibility requires pinning paper=https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16789, project=https://openbmb.github.io/ToolBench/, code=https://github.com/OpenBMB/ToolBench, data=https://github.com/OpenBMB/ToolBench, plus the exact split, runtime, scorer, prompt/scaffold, and release revision.

输入来自 RapidAPI 文档、过滤后的 API 模式，以及由 闭源聊天模型生成的单工具和多工具用户指令。输出包括用户指令、检索到的 API、工具调用链、API 观测、最终答案或失败状态，以及 ToolEval 判断。底层环境是 RapidAPI 工具库、API 检索器、DFSDT 解题路径搜索和 ToolEval 评审器。

流程可以压缩成五步：1. 收集并过滤 RapidAPI 工具；2. 生成工具使用指令；3. 搜索可行的 API 调用路径；4. 用 ToolEval 对完整工具使用轨迹给出通过率或胜率判断；5. 在固定 API 快照、检索方式、评审模型和划分下比较分数。复现时必须固定 arXiv 论文、OpenBMB 项目页、ToolBench 仓库、API 快照、提示或脚手架、DFSDT 预算和评审器版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The arXiv abstract verifies 16,464 real-world RESTful APIs across 49 categories, closed-chat-model-generated instructions, solution-path annotation, ToolLLaMA fine-tuning, and zero-shot generalization to APIBench.

Instance-level evidence comes from the released task object and the scorer: ToolEval uses closed-model judgments of pass rate and win rate over full tool-use trajectories. Aggregate scores are meaningful only for the reported split, model setup, and harness. Public artifacts support inspection, but they do not remove contamination, dependency, or license checks.

arXiv 摘要确认了 16,464 个真实 RESTful API、49 个类别、由 闭源聊天模型生成指令、标注解题路径、微调 ToolLLaMA，并在 APIBench 上做零样本泛化评测。

样本级证据来自工具模式、调用链、API 观测和 ToolEval 评审。聚合分数只对论文报告的 API 快照、划分、模型设置和评审器成立。公开工件便于复查，但不能自动消除 RapidAPI 漂移、教师与评审耦合、污染和许可风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is the scale and coupling of API collection, instruction generation, solution-path annotation, model training, retrieval, and evaluator design for real API use.

The prior-work baseline is narrower task lists, static benchmarks, or less stateful evaluation surfaces. What changes is the combination of task object, environment or data substrate, and feedback contract. What is not new is benchmarking or model scoring in general. Before reuse, inspect split policy, release license, artifact revision, scorer implementation, prompt/scaffold, and whether public examples have entered training data.

新意在于把真实 API 收集、指令生成、解题路径标注、模型训练、检索和评测器设计合成一个大规模工具使用体系。

已有基线通常是更窄的任务列表、静态 benchmark 或状态更弱的评测面。这里变化的是任务对象、环境或数据基底，以及反馈契约的组合。并不新的部分是做模型评测本身。复用前要检查划分策略、发布许可、工件版本、评分器实现、提示或脚手架，以及公开样本是否已经进入训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
RapidAPI services can drift, disappear, rate-limit, or require payment; the same closed-chat-model family is involved in instruction generation, path annotation, and evaluation, creating teacher-judge coupling.

Correctness is only relative to the released verifier or environment. A passing score may hide semantic failures outside the checked state, unobserved paths, tool/API drift, judge bias, public-task contamination, or scaffold-specific shortcuts. Do not read the benchmark as a universal verifier or as a reward signal without a separate audit.

RapidAPI 服务可能漂移、下线、限流或付费；同一类闭源聊天模型同时参与指令生成、路径标注和评测，会产生教师与评审耦合风险。

正确性只相对于已释放的验证器或环境成立。通过分数可能掩盖检查状态之外的语义错误、未覆盖路径、工具或 API 漂移、评审偏差、公开任务污染，或脚手架带来的捷径。不要把 benchmark 读成通用验证器，也不要未经单独审计就当成奖励信号。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Retain API snapshot, schema, instruction, retrieved APIs, tool-call path, observations, judge prompt/model, retriever setting, DFSDT budget, and split.

The card is useful as an evaluation-surface schema: it tells the reader what input, trajectory, output, scorer, and provenance fields must survive if the work is reused for benchmarking, filtering, analysis, or supervised training. Its value for the collection is the explicit feedback contract, not only the headline score.

复用时要保留 API 快照、模式、指令、检索到的工具、调用路径、观测、评审提示和模型、检索设置、DFSDT 预算和划分。

这张卡适合当作评测面 schema 使用：它说明如果下游要复用该工作进行评测、过滤、分析或监督训练，哪些输入、轨迹、输出、评分器和来源字段必须保留下来。它对库的价值在明确反馈契约，而不只是标题里的分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Separate ToolBench as data, ToolLLaMA as trained model, and ToolEval as judge; evidence for one component does not automatically validate the others.

Read the official paper first, then inspect the repository or dataset release. Keep data construction, model training, evaluation harness, judge/verifier, and leaderboard numbers separate. If a license, split, snapshot, or judge version is not pinned, treat comparisons as provisional.

阅读时要区分 ToolBench 数据、ToolLLaMA 模型和 ToolEval 评审器；一个组件的证据不能自动替另一个组件背书。

阅读顺序是先看官方论文，再看代码仓库或数据发布。要把数据构造、模型训练、评测框架、评审器或验证器、排行榜数字分开。如果许可、划分、快照或评审器版本没有固定，比较结论就只能视为暂定。
